data.name: Qayyam
data.gender_notes: Qayyam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who stands on the truth and is steadfast, as described in the Quran for Prophet Elijah (Al-Kheez in Arabic). The name Qayyam carries the meaning “The Perpetual One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qayyam usually hope their child will grow to embody the perpetual one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes commitment, determination, and perseverance in following the truth and staying steadfast in one's beliefs
data.etymology: Qayyam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Perpetual One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qayyam total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
data.cultural_impact: The name "Qayyam" holds significant cultural importance due to its association with Prophet Elijah in Islamic tradition. In Arabic, this name is spelled as "Al-Qaheet" or "Al-Qayyam", and it is mentioned in Surah Al-Anbiya' (verse 90) of the Quran. Prophet Elijah is a revered figure in Islam, as he is considered one of the chosen messengers of God. This name highlights the virtues of endurance, resilience, and faithfulness in the face of challenges.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name "Qayyam" embodies the qualities of being steadfast in faith and adhering to truth. It is a reminder that no matter what trials and tribulations one faces in life, one should remain undeterred in their commitment to following the righteous path. The name further signifies the importance of staying rooted in one's beliefs and values, and being committed to serving God and spreading good in the world. As individuals, we can strive to live up to the spiritual meaning of this name, even if it is not part of our personal name.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Perpetual One" symbolizes One who stands on the truth and is steadfast, as described in the Quran for Prophet Elijah (Al-Kheez in Arabic). In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Qayyam serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the perpetual one.
